`src/lib/gen/**/*.go` (8 files: Peeroleum, Peregrination, Somewhere, test/*, N/, Story/…) are
 **generated** by the Lang compile pipeline — each starts `// GENERATED by Lang compile — do
  not edit by hand.` They're git-tracked so they surface in greps and file lists.

**Why:** they are compiled OUTPUT of `.g` LangTiles source, not authored code.

**How to apply:** exclude them when grepping to understand the machine (`--exclude-dir=gen`
 or pathspec `:!src/lib/gen`); never edit a `.go` — edit the `.g` source and recompile. The
  `.go` extension here means "generated", unrelated to Golang. See [[mundanestation-ttlilt-determinism]]
   (Story_cli_docs.md restates this).
